content.value_statement: Document extraction in .NET requires correct Azure models, authentication, and result handling. This skill provides focused C# workflows for analysis, classification, and custom model management.
actual_capabilities: Installs Azure.AI.DocumentIntelligence and Azure.Identity packages for .NET projects.
Configures Microsoft Entra ID or API key authentication from environment variables.
Analyzes invoices, receipts, layouts, text, tables, and document fields with prebuilt models.
Builds custom template models and document classifiers from Azure Blob Storage sources.
Classifies documents and reports document types with confidence values.
Lists, retrieves, and deletes custom models through the administration client.
limitations: Requires an Azure AI Document Intelligence resource, valid credentials, and network access.
Example document URLs and storage addresses are placeholders that must be replaced.
Extracted values can be uncertain and require confidence checks and business validation.
The guidance does not cover deployment, pricing, regional availability, or production monitoring.

use_cases.title: Automate invoice intake
use_cases.description: Extract vendor names, totals, and line items for an accounting workflow.

use_cases.title: Index document archives
use_cases.description: Extract page text, tables, and structure for search and downstream processing.

use_cases.title: Train specialized document models
use_cases.description: Build custom models and classifiers for organization-specific forms and document types.

prompt_templates.title: Configure authentication
prompt_templates.prompt: Show me how to configure a .NET console app with Azure AI Document Intelligence using DefaultAzureCredential and environment variables.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for a new application

prompt_templates.title: Analyze an invoice
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a C# workflow that analyzes an invoice URI and safely reads vendor, total, and line item fields with confidence checks.
prompt_templates.scenario: Basic extraction with a prebuilt model

prompt_templates.title: Extract layout data
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a C# routine that extracts page text and tables with prebuilt-layout, including clear handling for failed Azure requests.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate layout analysis and error handling

prompt_templates.title: Plan a custom model pipeline
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan an advanced .NET pipeline that builds a custom neural model, creates a classifier, validates confidence, and manages model lifecycle operations.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced custom model and classifier workflow

output_examples.input: Analyze an invoice from a URI and list important fields.
output: Extract VendorName, InvoiceTotal, and Items only after checking each field type.
Review confidence values before sending results to accounting.

output_examples.input: Outline a custom model training workflow for fixed-layout forms.
output_examples.output: Use the administration client with a Blob Storage SAS source and a unique model identifier. Select template mode and review the completed model schema.

output_examples.input: Explain how to classify a document with an existing classifier.
output_examples.output: Provide the classifier identifier and document URI, wait for completion, then inspect each document type and confidence value.

best_practices: Prefer DefaultAzureCredential for production and use a custom Azure resource subdomain.
Reuse client instances because the Azure SDK clients are thread-safe.
Check field and classification confidence before accepting extracted values.
anti_patterns: Do not embed API keys or SAS tokens in source code.
Do not treat example URLs as production document locations.
Do not delete models without confirming the identifier and lifecycle policy.

faq.question: Which NuGet packages are required?
faq.answer: Use Azure.AI.DocumentIntelligence for document operations and Azure.Identity for Microsoft Entra ID authentication.

faq.question: Which authentication method should production applications use?
faq.answer: Prefer DefaultAzureCredential with a custom Azure resource subdomain. Use API keys only when identity-based authentication is unsuitable.

faq.question: Which prebuilt models does the skill cover?
faq.answer: It covers read, layout, invoice, receipt, identity document, business card, W-2, and health insurance card models.

faq.question: Can the skill build custom models and classifiers?
faq.answer: Yes. It shows administration client workflows using training data from Azure Blob Storage.

faq.question: Does the skill show local file analysis?
faq.answer: The examples use document URIs. Check the current Azure SDK API before adapting the workflow for local content.

faq.question: Are extracted fields guaranteed to be correct?
faq.answer: No. Review field types and confidence values, then apply validation appropriate for the business process.
